FULL TEXT:
Department of Anthropology, Panjab University, Chandigarh
21 April, 2023
ADVERTISEMENT
Application are invited for one post of Research Investigator in Social Impact assessment
Project entitled “Construction of Railway Line from Bhanupali to Bilaspur Beri, Tehsil
Nangal in Disrtic Rupnagar” for two months or till the completion of the project, whichever is
earlier. Application may be submitted on a plain paper along with detailed bio-data and attested
copies of certificates and work experience to the undersigned and soft copy may be submitted at
anthro@pu.ac.in within five working days after the date of advertisement.
Date of Interview will be intimated latter in due course.
Essential qualifications:
i.) M.A/M. Sc in Anthropology with minimum 55%marks for General candidates (50%
in case of SC/ST candidates).
ii.) The Age of candidate should be below 40 years.
Desirable: Knowledge of field work and candidate should be willing to conduct
independent fieldwork/data collection.
Remuneration: Rs. 35000/- per month consolidated.
No T.A/D.A is permissible for appearing in the interview.
Dr. Ramesh Sahani,
Assistant Professor,
Department of Anthropology,
Panjab University,
Chandigarh.
